# Orthopedic injury matching

```{r}
library(readr)
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(metasnf)
library(MatchIt)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(fastDummies)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

input_path   <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/inputs")))
proc_path    <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))
fig_path     <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/figures")))
sub_path     <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/subjects")))
model_path   <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/models")))
unij_ns_subs <- readRDS(sub_path("2025_09_11_unij_no_sibs_subs.rds"))

core_path <- path_maker(here("data/abcd/core"))
import <- function(path) {
    return(abcd_load(core_path(path)))
}

ph_p_mhx <- import("physical-health/ph_p_mhx.csv")

oi_controls <- ph_p_mhx |> 
    filter_timepoint(0) |>
    filter_subjects(unij_ns_subs) |>
    dplyr::filter(medhx_6a == 1) |>
    pull(subjectkey)

length(oi_controls) # n = 1108

set.seed(42)
random_oi_subs <- sample(oi_controls, size = 438)

matched_config <- readRDS(proc_path("2025_10_01_matched_config.rds"))

subject_filter_dl <- function(data_list, subject_vector) {
    data_list <- data_list |>
        dlapply(
            function(x) {
                keep_subs <- x$"data"$"uid" %in% subject_vector
                x$"data" <- x$"data"[keep_subs, ]
                return(x)
            }
        )
    return(data_list)
}

all_dls_h_ns <- readRDS(proc_path("2025_09_11_all_dls_h_no_sibs.rds"))
unij_dl_u1 <- all_dls_h_ns$"unij_all_u_dls"$"imp_1"
unij_ol_u1 <- all_dls_h_ns$"unij_all_u_ols"$"imp_1"

random_oi_dl <- subject_filter_dl(
    unij_dl_u1,
    paste0("uid_", random_oi_subs)
)

random_oi_ol <- subject_filter_dl(
    unij_ol_u1,
    paste0("uid_", random_oi_subs)
)

random_oi_sol_df <- progressr::with_progress(
    batch_snf(
        random_oi_dl,
        matched_config,
        processes = 48
    )
)

saveRDS(random_oi_sol_df, proc_path("random_oi_sol_df", TRUE))

random_oi_ext_sol_df <- extend_solutions(
    random_oi_sol_df,
    dl = random_oi_dl,
    target_dl = random_oi_ol,
    min_pval = 1e-10,
    processes = 48
)
saveRDS(random_oi_ext_sol_df, proc_path("random_oi_ext_sol_df.rds", TRUE))


random_oi_ext_sol_df_3c <- random_oi_ext_sol_df |>
    dplyr::filter(nclust == 3)

random_oi_dfs <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(random_oi_ext_sol_df_3c)),
    function(x) {
        auto_plot(
            random_oi_ext_sol_df_3c[x, ],
            dl = c(random_oi_dl, random_oi_ol),
            return_plots = FALSE
        )
    }
)

random_oi_dfs[[1]] |> topologizer()

mtbi_gen_fts_table_hits_t <- read_csv(proc_path("2025_09_22_mtbi_gen_fts_table_hits_t.csv"))
mtbi_gen_long <- na.omit(mtbi_gen_fts_table_hits_t)


random_oi_dfs[[1]]

oi_concordances <- lapply(
    random_oi_dfs,
    function(x) {
        concordance_w_mtbi_quick(x, mtbi_data = mtbi_gen_long)
    }
) |> unlist()
saveRDS(oi_concordances, proc_path("oi_concordances.rds", TRUE))

print(oi_concordances)

max(oi_concordances) # max concordance of 61%
```
